title: Creative Library presentation classifier does not recognize GeoPackage carriers
workflow: register GeoPackage-bearing Work -> rebuild Creative Library catalog -> browse modalities/carriers
symptom: .gpkg is absent from PRESENTATION_KIND_EXTENSIONS and therefore falls through to kind=other.
expected_behavior: A registered GeoPackage carrier should be discoverable as a geospatial modality while remaining non-browser-native.
actual_behavior: The exact carrier remains retained, but the current presentation projection would classify it as other and omit geospatial from modalities.
proposed_fix: Add a minimal geospatial presentation kind for .gpkg/.geojson/.kml without changing preservation format identity or making those files browser-direct.
fix_attempt: Workstation Creative Library added presentation kind geospatial for .gpkg/.geojson/.kml while deliberately leaving geospatial outside DIRECT_KINDS.
verification: Workstation canonical resolution commit 1f0bbf2e981a84dbd43233da947a49447722f95e; unit suite 9/9 PASS; Creative Library projection classified this Work’s .gpkg carrier as geospatial without claiming browser-direct support.
